regime.interpretation: Robinhood remains the dominant speculative-velocity outlier: DEX activity is accelerating while broad-market DEX activity and most major competing chains are contracting. Negative net inflows alongside very high turnover remains consistent with capital recycling/high velocity rather than simple passive inflows.

arb_spillover_revision.reason: Robinhood Chain revenue does accrue to the Arbitrum DAO treasury, but ARB itself has no direct protocol cash flow. DefiLlama token rights shows fee switch off, no buybacks, no dividends, no burns, and zero token-holder net income. Therefore the Robinhood revenue link is governance/treasury value rather than direct holder cash-flow capture.
arb_spillover_revision.forward_test_implication: Do not treat ARB as a revenue-share token in future scoring. Any ARB response to Robinhood Chain should be scored as narrative/governance/treasury spillover and discounted for leverage and unlock risk.
